label: Composition order (engine doctrine)
semantics: Fields compose in a fixed order: base -> muscle field -> tissue field -> gravity/drape acting on the tissue over the MUSCLED shape. Fat drapes over whatever is under it; a power belly hangs from a built core. The vector-layer evaluation mirrors this: authoring (dial fills) -> distribution factors -> muscle (passes through untouched) -> tissue (regional tissue, attenuation, show-through, power-belly terms). Gravity itself is geometry-stage; its parameters (mobility, core share, tilt) are derived at the tissue stage.
